name: MD-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Glenn Ivey running with strong fundraising
Republican nominee lacks visible funding or campaign infrastructure
Prediction markets price near-certain Democratic win
model.rationale: A D+39 seat with an incumbent Democrat who has raised over $670,000 against an unfunded Republican challenger leaves essentially no path for an upset, and markets agree at roughly 97% for Ivey. The forecast stays anchored to the district's fundamentals.
model.watch: Only an extraordinary scandal or third-party surge could put this seat in play, and there is no sign of either.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Maryland's 4th District is one of the most Democratic-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of D+39. Incumbent Glenn Ivey is running for reelection after winning the seat in 2022, and he has built a substantial financial advantage, raising about $674,000 with roughly $459,000 on hand.

His Republican opponent, George McDermott, shows no reported fundraising or outside support, and a Green Party candidate is also on the ballot. Prediction markets price Ivey's chances at about 97%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no competitive polling and no expert raters flagging the race, this sits firmly in Safe D territory.
